name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Growth & Activation | Funnel Design, Onboarding Journeys, Experimentation & AI Prototyping
summary: Growth operator who designs the journey from first touch to value realized, then measures where users drop and fixes it. Built Solenzo's product-led acquisition loop from zero: a free audit as the activation moment, automated scoring, segmented follow-up, and conversion to paid. Owned onboarding and launch for 25+ SaaS customers a month at Wix while leading a team of 20, and designed partner onboarding at Birdeye that retained ~94% of the book. Prototypes flows directly in HTML/CSS and with AI coding tools, including Claude Code, and treats funnel data and A/B test results as design inputs, not after-the-fact validation.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Designed and shipped a product-led acquisition loop from zero: a free digital-footprint audit as the first-value moment, automated scoring, and follow-up segmented by what each audit found. 180+ businesses enrolled and 2 converted to paid.

Architected 20+ lifecycle workflows mapping the full journey, from capture and qualification through booking, no-show recovery, onboarding nurture, reactivation, and review asks, each stage instrumented so drop-off is visible.

Prototype landing pages and flows directly in HTML/CSS and with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Zapier/Make/n8n code steps in Python and JavaScript), using working code as the fastest way to test an idea.
Diagnosed on-site conversion friction as the real bottleneck on a client's Google Ads funnel after cutting low-quality leads, tracing the problem past acquisition into the page experience.
A/B test email subject lines and content, and report funnel progression, conversion, and drop-off in GA4 and CRM dashboards to decide what changes next.
Design agent logic and rubric-based evaluation loops for AI-generated output, balancing automation speed against output quality and user trust.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Produced conversion-focused landing pages and multi-touch email sequences, and ran A/B-tested LinkedIn campaigns against small, highly researched audiences.
Built reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, turning results into optimization recommendations for cross-functional teams.

experience.title: Customer Onboarding & Activation (Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding)
bullets: Designed automated onboarding and product-training sequences that reduced time-to-first-value friction for a 15-20 partner network, retaining all but one (~94%).
Analyzed utilization data to locate adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Fed structured, prioritized user feedback to Product and Engineering that shaped the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Led the sales team at a performance marketing agency, analyzing campaign data and recommending changes across paid media and creative.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Owned onboarding and launch for 25+ customers per month on a self-serve SaaS platform, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Contributed to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment through site architecture, SEO, and conversion guidance.
Managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for two years (20, later 8): 1:1s, training, hiring support, and raising the quality bar across the team.
Advised on A/B test design for a Salesforce workflow-automation effort, defining test structure and success criteria.
Drove process improvements for a new vertical that grew from proof of concept to a profitable business line.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans and guided workflow design for CRM and project-management software, ranking top three in sales on a team that grew from 8 to 15 reps.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (Sept 2024)
